gates.acceptance: Read exact LightSpeed local HEAD/origin/divergence and root/runtime pointers against current provider; investigate earlier unverified root-pointer correction
gates.hold: Do not presume checkout CURRENT from a previous audit

gates.title: Source authority reconciliation
gates.acceptance: Owner accepts cross references among Raphael PR6, UTP PR5 and Data PR11; no duplicate material/equation authority
gates.hold: No unapproved merge or authority promotion

gates.title: Physical material passport evidence
gates.acceptance: Populate actual values/units/uncertainties/lot/calibration for 531 measurement slots; baseline 0 filled
gates.hold: Do not invent values; missing remains null

gates.title: Equation operand resolution
gates.acceptance: Trace 172 operand requirements and seven flagged schema gaps; quantify error budgets
gates.hold: 59 screening models do not replace qualified nonlinear solver

gates.title: Directional transition qualification
gates.acceptance: Target 12 priority candidate material routes, X→Y and reverse, non-adjacent cumulative histories, process-environment and contamination tests

gates.title: Printer-1 / gas cell preparation
gates.acceptance: List actual tools/sensors and access, safe benign coupons, controlled test protocol, operator and emergency stop

gates.title: Butter Bot printer-first full-component reference programme
gates.acceptance: Map all BB01 components and interfaces; BB02 modular process research; BB03 integrated informed candidate; fabricate/automatically integrate a complete Butter Bot in one cycle without opening or de-sealing main enclosure. Automated placement of safely pre-staged externally made ICs/other modules is allowed; separately track how much is truly additively fabricated. Qualification requires verified sealed-cycle evidence plus independent product safety/functional evidence.
gates.hold: No unsealed operator repositioning in a claimed one-session build; do not misrepresent pre-staged chips as directly printed. No butter-delivery benchmark, no lab-arm redesign, no physical actuation authority from documentation.

gates.title: CGX phone-like device architecture
gates.acceptance: Complete display/radio/power/SoC architecture and PCB/printed RF structures, security, EMC, energy, repairability and test plan
gates.hold: No fully printed smartphone SoC claim

gates.title: Eco-Grex acoustic/habitat demonstrator

gates.title: Solar Hull / Mark III/V / space ladder
gates.acceptance: Trace units/compartments, mass/power/thermal/structural/EM/RF budgets, microgravity manufacturing and independent mission/flight qualification

gates.title: Socie-Civil M1 and river nodes

gates.title: Eco/ISRU recovered feed and post-mix chemistry

gates.title: 80-product portfolio coverage and shared modules

gates.title: Owner review / production / release decision

gates.hold: No public claims, production commands, root promotion or unreviewed merges

evidence_caveat: Schema/test/CI are software evidence; local checkout proof must be read back after write; never treat physical tests as complete based on software.

butter_bot_founder_direction.primary_goal: Qualify a printer/process system capable of fabricating the entire simple known-geometry Butter Bot in one manufacturing session, attempting printable pathways for every component.
butter_bot_founder_direction.development_sequence: BB01 baseline component/geometry compatibility; BB02 recursive modularisation; BB03 informed integrated refinement; more iterations as needed; only qualified endpoint receives unversioned Butter Bot name.
not_objectives: Butter delivery as R&D success benchmark
Fixed-base bench-assistant design as BB01 starting target
butter_bot_founder_direction.later_derivative: Specialised desk/bench assistant robotics after Butter Bot manufacturing learning curve
butter_bot_founder_direction.active_founder_question: Must the completed robot pass an in-enclosure powered functional self-test before the sealed manufacturing cycle ends, or can powered commissioning begin after removal?
butter_bot_founder_direction.operating_hold: No physical operation, high-risk chemistry, root promotion, deployment or PR merge without separate authority.

single_session_founder_ruling.outer_enclosure: Must remain sealed and unopened from cycle start through cycle completion; any manual opening mid-build terminates qualification as a single session.
allowed_during_seal: robotic tool/material access from pre-staged internal shelves or magazines
automated integration of externally manufactured components such as semiconductor chips, pre-staged without opening the process enclosure
prohibited_mid_cycle: operator opening or de-sealing outer process enclosure
manual assembly/repositioning requiring outer seal breach
single_session_founder_ruling.provenance_requirement: Keep direct-printed content separate from vendor-made or preloaded components; a sealed one-session complete Butter Bot need not be composed of 100% directly printed parts, but all-component printing research remains in scope.
single_session_founder_ruling.cross_product: Design automated tooling/component-access interface for wider product families, not only Butter Bot.
